newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P affirms A2 rating for Korea Exchange Bank.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms A2 rating for Korea Exchange Bank.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Wednesday that it had affirmed Korea Exchange Bank's short-term debt rating of A2.
The action reflects Korea Exchange Bank's manageable exposure to Hanbo Steel Co, which filed for bankruptcy last week, S&P said in a statement.
The bank is a member of a consortium that provided nearly five trillion won to the steel company, it said.
S&P said that it would continue to closely monitor the bank's overall credit quality and other financial measures under the increasingly difficult domestic operating environment.
